description: This file defines the LDAPTestSyncService class, which extends LDAPSyncService, to provide LDAP synchronization for testing purposes within the OrangeHRM system. It manages LDAP service instantiation and configuration based on LDAP settings.

classes.name: LDAPTestSyncService
classes.description: A service class that extends LDAPSyncService to facilitate LDAP synchronization testing with custom settings and LDAP service instantiation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the LDAPTestSyncService with specified LDAP settings.

methods.name: getLDAPService
methods.description: Retrieves the LDAP service instance, initializing and binding it if necessary, with support for anonymous or authenticated bind based on settings.

methods.name: getLDAPSetting
methods.description: Returns the LDAP settings object associated with this service.
